labels: offsets read BEFORE the fill, never at it. Anonymous depth is never identified as L5's order. An old snapshot is the CURRENT state -- the capture writes only on change -- carried at most 60s, the collector's own REST resync interval. Undetectable delta drift within that interval is the dataset's stated accuracy bound and applies to every offset here.

accuracy_bound.why: ~24k events/s with no sequence numbers: a dropped delta cannot be detected from the stream, and the 60s REST resync is what bounds the resulting drift
